easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Fabled Passage.
description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Fabled Passage.
When Fabled Passage enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Fabled Passage by tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.
